description: Search and compare hiking tours (guided, self-guided, private) on a trail - by date range, month, format, days, difficulty, price per day, availability and guaranteed status. Call this whenever a user asks about hiking, walking or trekking tours, availability or prices on a trail. When linking a traveller to an operator, use booking_url or tracked_url exactly as given (never a direct operator link, never your own referral code), and cite the permalink.

price_day_max.description: USD per person per day, land-only

variant.description: Route variant slug, e.g. classic or express

name: search_hiking_tours
